result.stdout:
Usage: nildiff [reportLabel] [options] Arguments: Absolute path to the baseline (old) folder. Absolute path to the comparison (new) folder. [reportLabel] Optional label used as the subfolder name under Reports/. When omitted, a high-resolution timestamp label is auto-generated. Options: --help, -h Show this help message and exit. --version Show the application version and exit. --banner Show the ASCII-art banner and exit. --print-config Print the effective configuration as indented JSON and exit. --validate-config Validate the configuration file and exit (0=valid, 3=invalid). --no-pause Skip key-wait at process end. --config Path to config.json (default: /config.json). --threads Override MaxParallelism (0 = auto). --no-il-cache Disable the IL cache for this run. --clear-cache Interactive wizard to selectively delete IL cache files. --skip-il Skip IL comparison for .NET assemblies. --no-timestamp-warnings Suppress timestamp-regression warnings. --creator Apply the default maintainer IL ignore profile. --creator-il-ignore-profile Apply a maintainer-managed IL ignore profile and enable IL string filtering. --wizard Interactive mode: prompts for old/new folders and an optional report label. Shows existing report folders before the label prompt; press Enter to auto-generate. Drag-and-drop friendly. --dry-run Enumerate files and show statistics without running comparison. --coffee Use coffee-themed spinner animation during execution. --beer Use beer-themed spinner animation during execution. --matcha Use matcha tea ceremony spinner animation during execution. --whisky Use whisky distilling spinner animation during execution. --wine Use wine making spinner animation during execution. --ramen Use ramen steaming spinner animation during execution. --sushi Use conveyor-belt sushi spinner animation during execution. --random-spinner Randomly select a spinner theme for each run. --credits Show credits and acknowledgements. --bell Ring terminal bell when execution completes. --output Output directory for reports (default: /Reports/). --log-format Log file output format (default: text). 'json' emits NDJSON lines for SIEM/log aggregation. --open-reports Open the Reports folder in the file manager. Respects --output if specified. --open-config Open the config folder in the file manager. Respects --config if specified. --open-logs Open the Logs folder in the file manager. Environment variables (override config.json values): FOLDERDIFF_MAXPARALLELISM= Override MaxParallelism. FOLDERDIFF_ENABLEILCACHE= Enable/disable the IL cache. FOLDERDIFF_ILCACHEDIRECTORYABSOLUTEPATH=

IL cache directory path. FOLDERDIFF_SKIPIL= Skip IL comparison. FOLDERDIFF_SHOULDGENERATEHTMLREPORT= Generate HTML report. Any FOLDERDIFF_= key overrides the matching config.json property (bool: true/false/1/0, int: integer). Exit codes: 0 Success. 2 Invalid arguments or input paths. 3 Configuration load or parse error. 4 Diff execution or report generation failure. 1 Unexpected internal error. Tip: Use --print-config to display the effective configuration (config.json + environment variable + supported CLI overrides) as JSON and exit. This is useful for verifying which settings are active before a run.
